meta.name: add-macos-statusbar
meta.description: Add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw. Shows a bolt icon with a green/red dot indicating whether NanoClaw is running, with Start, Stop, and Restart controls. macOS only.

copy.tagline: 在菜单栏显示 NanoClaw 运行状态并控制启停
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 macOS 菜单栏快速查看和切换 NanoClaw 运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Show NanoClaw status and controls in macOS menu bar
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly check and toggle NanoClaw from the macOS menu bar

howto.what: 会在 macOS 菜单栏加一个闪电图标,用绿点或红点显示 NanoClaw 是否在运行,并提供 Start、Stop、Restart 控制。图标点击后还能查看日志。仅支持 macOS。
howto.when: 当你在 macOS 上要求给 NanoClaw 加菜单栏状态指示器时触发。非 macOS 会停止并提示;缺少 swiftc 时会让你先安装 Xcode 命令行工具。

say.note: 先检查 macOS 和 swiftc,再编译并安装服务

howto.what_en: Adds a bolt icon to the macOS menu bar that shows whether NanoClaw is running (green or red dot), with Start, Stop and Restart controls. macOS only.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw. On non-macOS it stops with a notice; without swiftc it asks you to install Xcode Command Line Tools.

say_en.text: Add a menu bar status icon for NanoClaw
say_en.note: Checks macOS and swiftc, then compiles and installs
